Proposition
[Nonconvexity would force a topological contradiction] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0320, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0321, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0322 ↗ appb-thm-toponogov-comparison ↗ appb-lem-halfspace-totally-convex 1. Proposition B.54\group comparison-theorems

If $\sec (g)\ge 0$, then the relevant half spaces and Busemann sublevel sets are totally convex, and the proof by contradiction using a minimal geodesic loop closes.
